decisionRule: ACCEPT only if there are zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX findings. One SHOULD-FIX survived refutation, therefore REJECT.
discipline: Independent. Refute, do not confirm. The subject was checked against all eighteen recorded inputs, frozen language-quality leftover-join.v3 and v2, frozen sdk leftover-join.v6 and v5, the D-056/D-113/D-165/D-184/D-206/D-267/D-271 lineage, live file-08 and COORD state, the complete v3-to-v4 semantic delta, both historical finding dispositions, the exact ten-obligation partition, all four protected leftover obligations, and every dispatched attack. The current Claude review of this v4 subject was not opened, read, or used.
summary: REJECT at 0 blockers, 0 MUST-FIX, and 1 SHOULD-FIX. The v4 remainder measurement itself is sound: language-quality leftoverDesign remains exactly OBL-THRESHOLDS, OBL-MATRIX-CORPUS, and OBL-G13-RESERVED; sdk leftover-join.v6 remains current for DR-125 with OBL-G20-FX-AUTHORING and OBL-SDK-API-RESERVED; DR-118 remains DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED; DR-107 remains PROPOSED-CLOSED-FOR-REVIEW; required-now remains 28; v3 is current at draft time and historical only after successor recording; and no satisfaction, authoring, naming, or implementation boundary is crossed. However, both finding dispositions say their repairs landed at language-quality leftover-join.v3. Frozen v2 explicitly lands both repairs, was dual-ACCEPTed and recorded at D-165, while v3 merely carries them forward. The landing provenance must name v2, not v3.

findings.title: Both historical repairs are attributed to the wrong landing artifact
findings.charge: The v4 subject says CLAUDE-LQLJ-V1-SF1 and LQLJ-V1-SF1 landed in this lineage at leftover-join.v3. Frozen language-quality leftover-join.v2 explicitly says in its purpose that v2 lands both findings, supplies the nonempty landing-site arrays, passed both independent reviews at 0/0, and was recorded at D-165. V3 is a later remasurement that carries the same repair forward; it is not the first landing artifact.
evidence: language-quality-leftover-join.v2 purpose states: 'v2 lands CLAUDE-LQLJ-V1-SF1 and LQLJ-V1-SF1.'
V2 findingDisposition entries mark both findings ACCEPTED and name obligations.OBL-DR125-ACTIVATION, summary.deferredOrRidesElsewhere, and proposedLaterWork as their landing sites.
Both v2 independent reviews returned ACCEPT with zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX, and D-165 records v2 as the DR-118 leftover-design measurement.
V3 carries those same disposition IDs and landing sites while remasuring against later live state; D-206 records that remasurement.

V4 changes the provenance prose to 'Landed in this lineage at leftover-join.v3' for both entries while leaving landedAt empty. The empty arrays correctly avoid a v4 re-landing, but do not cure the incorrect historical attribution.
findings.whyShouldFix: Finding-disposition provenance is part of the review lineage and must identify the artifact that actually landed each accepted repair. Naming v3 erases the accepted and recorded v2 landing and creates false custody for both findings.
findings.whyNotMustFix: The defect does not change an obligation bit, current-standing claim, digest, readiness token, or authority boundary. V4 correctly avoids re-landing the repairs and preserves their substance; only their landing provenance is wrong.
findings.repair: In a frozen successor, change both dispositions to say that the finding landed in language-quality leftover-join.v2 and was carried by leftover-join.v3, while retaining the statement that v4 does not re-land it and retaining empty v4 landedAt arrays. Do not edit this frozen subject in place.
